title: Comparative cytotoxicity and toxicological mechanisms of 6:2 Cl-PFAES and PFOS in pancreatic β cells: implications for glucose metabolism disruption
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1864-1876
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00046G, Paper
Xiao-Min Ren, Jianying Wang, Fenqing Zhao, Pingping Zhang, Huan He, Zhixiang Xu, Bin Huang, Xuejun Pan
This study found that 6:2 Cl-PFAES is more toxic than PFOS toward pancreatic β cells, inducing oxidative stress, apoptosis, and diabetes-related gene alterations, disrupting glucose metabolism.
